why: The reader names the header outright: in section 4 they list "the column header 'מול הבסיס'" as something they didn't understand. In section 5 they list "'מול הבסיס', and why there's a minus % for the fund I'm told to pick". That shows they don't know what the differences are measured against. They first raise it in the section 3 table, in the fund-list row, where they say the % column "made no sense". Before that they raise about nine other problems: the 10,000 ₪ starting amount, the words מחקה and סל, the made-up 7%, the words "תקרה למניה אחת", the inflation button, tax counted as a cost, paying more tax being good, whether they count as "צעיר", and the percentages on the fund card. That makes this the 10th problem raised.
